title: Baby Buddy Timeline 原作頁面視窗

source.versionNote: Screenshot added on 2022-01-30. No app version identified. Current source commit is not screenshot runtime version.
source.inspectionMethod: Independent direct-image and managed-preview Chromium desktop inspection
source.licenseBasis: Image is tracked in the same repository under docs/assets/images; root BSD-2-Clause license retained. No separate image-specific notice found in the pinned repository tree.

differences: Original PNG retained byte for byte, without crops, recoloring, translation, relabeling or redraw.
Neutral comparison header/footer added outside the image, containing ID, scope, source, copyright and license.
Image scales proportionally on narrow screens; no source mobile layout inferred.
referenceBoundary: Full original desktop screenshot viewport, not the entire scrollable timeline. The final wake-up entry is clipped in the source; missing content is not invented.
dataBoundary: Only the publicly documented original illustration is included. No project child/family records, photos, messages, credentials, models, production API or GCP access. Official image has a silhouette, not a child photograph. Screenshot example provenance is public documentation; exact data generator was not independently proven.
